learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how to recognize your feelings and express them beautifully through colors, lines, and creative art!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Art is like a magic mirror for your heart! It helps you show the world exactly how you are feeling inside, whether you are bursting with joy or feeling a little quiet and thoughtful.

Did you know that colors can actually speak? Warm colors like bright red and sunny yellow can show excitement or energy, while cool colors like deep blue and soft green often bring a gentle sense of calm and peace.

Lines have their own special language in the art world. Jagged and sharp zig-zag lines might mean you are feeling frustrated, while smooth and wavy flowing lines can show that you are relaxed and happy.

Our faces are the absolute best storytellers. By carefully observing and drawing different eye shapes, eyebrows, and smiles, you can bring characters to life and share powerful stories without saying a single word.

fun_activity.title: 🖍️ My Daily Emotion Wheel
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a large circle, divide it into four equal slices, and fill each slice with colors, shapes, and fun doodles that represent your four strongest feelings today!

quick_recap: ⭐ Art is a safe, fun, and beautiful way to express the emotions we hold inside.
⭐ We can use special colors, unique lines, and detailed facial expressions to clearly show our different moods.
